description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HandOver" name="Hand over order" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOver" targetRef="Participant_Logistics" messageRef="Msg_HandOverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Tracking" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTracking" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveTracking" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInfo"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DeliveryNotice" name="Delivery notice" sourceRef="Participant_Logistics" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery" messageRef="Msg_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFeedback" targetRef="StartEvent_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerOrder" name="Customer decides to order"/>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveTracking" name="Receive tracking information"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery" name="Receive delivery notice"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerReceived" name="Order delivered"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer wants to give feedback or return"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendFeedback" name="Send feedback or return request"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackSent" name="Feedback or return sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerOrder" targetRef="SendTask_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="SendTask_PlaceOrder" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveTracking" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveDelivery" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="SendTask_SendFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Online store order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OrderSystem" name="Order system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_GenerateConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_SendTracking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ReceiveTask_ReceiveStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Delivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_HandleFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FeedbackHandled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Warehouse" name="Warehouse team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ManualTask_PickAndPack</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_GenerateLabel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_HandOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderPlaced" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_GenerateLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Msg_HandOverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Msg_TrackingInfo"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_ReceiveStatus" name="Receive shipment status" messageRef="Msg_ShipmentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivered" name="Shipment reached customer address?" default="Flow_NotDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Successfully delivered"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Feedback" name="Customer feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_HandleFeedback" name="Handle feedback or return"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled" name="Feedback or return handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="ServiceTask_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="ServiceTask_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendConfirmation" targetRef="ManualTask_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="ManualTask_PickAndPack" targetRef="ServiceTask_GenerateLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="ServiceTask_GenerateLabel" targetRef="SendTask_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_HandOver" targetRef="SendTask_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTracking" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveStatus" targetRef="Gateway_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${shipmentDelivered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDelivered" name="No, keep monitoring" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="ReceiveTask_ReceiveStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="StartEvent_Feedback" targetRef="UserTask_HandleFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="UserTask_HandleFeedback" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
